adds.title: Cayman Government enforcement incidents - 1998 Tourism Ministry cruise ban and 2008 police arrest
adds.summary: In 1998 Cayman Islands tourism authorities with government approval turned away Norwegian Cruise Lines Leeward carrying 900 gay passengers on the stated basis that the group could not be counted on to uphold expected standards of visitor behavior, and in 2008 Cayman police after repeated warnings arrested a U.S. male visitor for kissing his boyfriend in public and later released him, establishing that same-sex public affection risks official exclusion, warning and arrest within an environment where same-sex activity was decriminalized only by imposed UK order in 2000-2001, sexual orientation is excluded from constitutional non-discrimination protection, same-sex couples have no legal standing, age of consent remains unequal at 16 for heterosexual and 21 for homosexual conduct, there are no gay venues, and public intimacy by both gay and straight visitors is treated as unacceptable.
